truth: MIXED: The parameter feeds its outer or default read. A same-line read of a block, loop, switch or catch local takes that local instead.
MIXED: Fixed indexes select their key, and a dynamic index selects at runtime. JSX conservatively refuses each bracket chain.
MIXED: The bracket selects a, p.b selects b, and wrap(p) receives the entire object. The JSX bracket edge is outside the admitted projection.
MIXED: The JSX value reads the outer box.value. A prior inner-field read or a value read before the field write cannot represent it.
MIXED: The final box replaces all fields of the earlier box. keep retains z and the later explicit c retains y after the nested spread.
